class.name: CabinComponentInfo
class.brief_description: A control a cab's implementation can make.
class.description: What [method CabinSystem.component_list] lists of an implementation: the name it makes the control by ([method CabinSystem.component_create]), its title for a list, the class of the cab widget it is, and the vehicle commands it sends.

members.member: The vehicle commands the control sends ([method VehicleServer.vehicle_send_command]).
The name the implementation makes the control by.
The control's title for a list.
The class of the cab widget the control is, e.g. [code]CabinButton[/code], [code]CabinSwitch[/code], [code]CabinKnob[/code], [code]CabinGauge[/code].
